The '''Silerian Stall''' was an aerial maneuver in which a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] came to an abrupt halt, causing pursuing ships to overtake and become easy targets. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]] executed such a maneuver in a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] while fighting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] with members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] at [[Eiattu 6]].
